about: I am a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK). My research focuses on digital health, HIV prevention and sexual health, vaccination, and health behavior change.

focus.name: Digital Health
focus.description: Digital interventions, conversational tools, and technology-supported health promotion and healthcare delivery.

focus.name: HIV & Sexual Health
focus.description: HIV self-testing, counseling, linkage to care, and prevention among key populations.

focus.name: Vaccination & Health Behavior
focus.description: Theory-guided interventions to improve vaccine uptake and preventive behaviors.

focus.name: Evidence Synthesis & Trials
focus.description: Randomized controlled trials, implementation research, and systematic reviews.

education.institution: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

news.text: Published a systematic review and meta-analysis on digital interventions for medication adherence in PLOS Digital Health.
Awarded the Faculty Postdoctoral Fellowship Scheme at CUHK.
Published a randomized clinical trial on chatbot-delivered HIV self-testing support in JAMA Network Open.
Received the Best PhD Thesis Award at CUHK.
Successfully defended my PhD thesis at CUHK.
Started a visiting research appointment at Yale University.

about_paragraphs: I am a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK). My research focuses on digital health, HIV prevention and sexual health, vaccination, and health behavior change.

I received my PhD in Public Health from CUHK and hold a Master of Public Health and a Master of International Public Health from UNSW Sydney. During my doctoral training, I was a Visiting Research Scholar at Yale University.
My work involves randomized controlled trials, epidemiological surveys, systematic reviews and meta-analyses, and the development and evaluation of evidence-based digital health interventions.
